method: Direct organic-result observation. NO keyword tool is available; observedVolume is null for every query BY POLICY and no figure is estimated anywhere.
instrumentLimits: Ranked organic result sets only — paid ads, Local Pack, People Also Ask and AI Overviews are NOT visible. Positions are directional, not exact.

observations.finding: OBSERVED: eight of nine organic results are 'properties for sale' inventory. Exactly one result addresses an owner who wants to sell. INFERRED: Google is resolving the ambiguous 'sell / for sale' token toward buyer inventory because no sell-side page has earned the slot. This is an intent-resolution VACUUM, not a saturated SERP.
observations.competitorWeakness: OBSERVED: the single sell-side result (sellcommercialpropertyusa.com) is a national template — its footer carries 200+ 'Sell Commercial Property in [City] [State]' links, contact is one individual, the Boise page carries essentially no Boise-specific content, and it states a '7 days or less' timeline with no mechanism. It explains no valuation method, no due-diligence process, no tenant handling and no environmental process.
observations.informationGap: INFERRED: the SERP is 100% about PROPERTIES and 0% about the SELLER'S DECISION. Nothing on it tells a Boise owner what their building is worth and how that number is derived, whether to use a broker's buyer pool or sell directly, what a sale nets them, how long it takes, what happens to their tenants, or what due diligence a buyer will run.
observations.strategicReading: INFERRED: this is the opposite of the residential picture. The residential head term is saturated with eight established local direct buyers; the commercial head term has NO credible local direct-buyer answer at all. Content with genuine Boise-specific substance is not competing against a strong incumbent here — it is competing against buy-side inventory that only ranks because nothing better exists.
